panels.description: The first two totals count OrdsSrvs resources; Pool Outcomes counts evaluated pools. All rows follow the Namespace and OrdsSrvs selections. Gray indicators have zero counts. Active Disabled counts are purple. Connection errors include timeouts.
Compact OrdsSrvs tile with rings scaled to 70%, resource status, pool health, and pool count.

targets.expr: sum by (state) (ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs",state="Healthy"})
sum by (state) (ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs",state="Preparing"})
sum by (state) (ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs",state="Progressing"})
sum by (state) (ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs",state="Degraded"})
sum by (state) (ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs",state="Unhealthy"})
sum by (state) (ordssrvs_pools_health{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"})

(ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} == 1)
* on(namespace, ordssrvs) group_left(pool_health)
label_replace(
  ordssrvs_pools_health{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} == 1,
  "pool_health", "$1", "state", "(.*)"
)
* on(namespace, ordssrvs) group_left(total, ok, failed, pools)
(
  label_join(
    (
    count_values by(namespace, ordssrvs)("total", (ordssrvs_pool_total_count{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} unless on(namespace, ordssrvs) (ordssrvs_pools_health{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs", state="Disabled"} == 1)))
    * on(namespace, ordssrvs) group_left(ok)
    count_values by(namespace, ordssrvs)("ok", (ordssrvs_pool_ok_count{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} unless on(namespace, ordssrvs) (ordssrvs_pools_health{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs", state="Disabled"} == 1)))
    * on(namespace, ordssrvs) group_left(failed)
    count_values by(namespace, ordssrvs)("failed", (ordssrvs_pool_failed_count{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} unless on(namespace, ordssrvs) (ordssrvs_pools_health{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs", state="Disabled"} == 1)))
    ),
    "pools", "/", "ok", "total"
  )
  or on(namespace, ordssrvs)
  group by(namespace, ordssrvs)(ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"})
)
* on(namespace, ordssrvs) group_left(pools_last_checked)
(
  count_values by(namespace, ordssrvs)(
    "pools_last_checked",
    (1000 * max by(namespace, ordssrvs)(ordssrvs_pool_last_checked_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"}))
    unless on(namespace, ordssrvs)
    (ordssrvs_pools_health{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs", state="Disabled"} == 1)
  )
  or on(namespace, ordssrvs)
  group by(namespace, ordssrvs)(ordssrvs_status{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"})
)

label_replace((ordssrvs_pool_http_status_code{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} * on(namespace, ordssrvs, pool) group_left(outcome) (ordssrvs_pool_outcome{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} == 1)), "metric", "HTTP Code", "namespace", ".*")

label_replace(1000 * (ordssrvs_pool_last_checked_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} * on(namespace, ordssrvs, pool) group_left(outcome) (ordssrvs_pool_outcome{namespace=~"$namespace",ordssrvs=~"$ordssrvs"} == 1)), "metric", "Last Checked", "namespace", ".*")
